Guided Jet Ski Tours  ·  St. Petersburg, FL

Jet Ski the Gulf.
Land on an Island.

Brand-new Yamaha WaveRunners, a local guide out front, and a route that runs from St. Pete into open Gulf water. Egmont Key, Shell Key, Fort De Soto, sandbars and dolphins, not a roped-off circle.


Check Availability


Call (813) 538-4802

★★★★★  5.0 · 600+ Google reviews

Brand-new Yamaha WaveRunners

Owner-operated · Guide on every tour

No hidden fees

Play

Pause

The Xtreme difference

Most rentals give you a buoy line. We give you the Gulf.

A lot of jet ski rentals keep you inside a small marked zone, or idling through no-wake water for half your hour. We launch you toward open water with a local guide who knows where the calm water, the sandbars and the dolphins are that day.

Open water, not a circle

Ride the Gulf of Mexico, Boca Ciega Bay and Tampa Bay. We set boundaries each morning around the wind and tide, so you get the best water that's safe to ride.

A guide who knows these waters

Shallow grass flats, oyster bars, busy channels and changing tides. Your guide handles the navigation so you can just ride.

Built around your group

Relaxed cruise, high-speed runs, island hopping or wildlife. First-timers get a full orientation before launch, and experienced riders get room to open it up.


Explore the tours

Where the ride goes

Islands, passes and open Gulf

No two tours are the same. Tide, wind and wildlife change daily, and your route depends on the tour you pick. These are the places our guests talk about most.

Historic island

Egmont Key

A protected island refuge at the mouth of Tampa Bay. Historic lighthouse, Fort Dade ruins and turquoise shallows.

Boat access only

Shell Key Preserve

An undeveloped barrier island you can only reach by boat. White sand, shelling and shallow water.

Dolphin water

Fort De Soto & Bunces Pass

Deep blue water, strong tidal flow and some of the best dolphin activity in Tampa Bay, with the Sunshine Skyway on the horizon.

Keep your eyes open

Dolphins & wildlife

Dolphins, manatees, rays, sea turtles and coastal birds all live out here. Wildlife is never guaranteed, but it's a regular part of the ride.


Check Availability


Compare Tours

Tours & pricing

Pick your ride

Three ways to ride, 1 to 3 hours each. Two hours is the sweet spot for most guests: plenty of time to explore, stop at a sandbar and still get some speed in.

1–3 hours

Jet Ski Rental

Carve across Boca Ciega Bay and cruise past Fort De Soto, Shell Key and Egmont Key. Ask about the Early Bird ride for calmer water and fewer crowds.

From $125


Book

1–3 hours · guided

St. Pete Guided Tour

Shell Key, Fort De Soto, Pass-a-Grille and the downtown St. Pete waterfront. Skyline views, calm channels and a guide who knows every turn.

From $125


Book

Most popular

1–3 hours · guided

Egmont Key Adventure

Land on Egmont Key and walk the 1858 lighthouse grounds and the ruins of Fort Dade and Fort McIntosh. Sandbar stops, shelling and snorkeling along the way.

From $220


Book

Up to 2 riders per ski (400 lb max)  ·  Fuel included  ·  No deposit  ·  No passenger fees
Want the whole day? 5-hour Ultimate Island Hop, from $650 (by request) →

Owner-operated

Captain Mike leads the way

Xtreme is family-owned and run by locals who know Tampa Bay, the Intracoastal and the Gulf inside and out. Captain Mike leads the tours, so you get safe navigation, the best wildlife spots and real photo stops without the guesswork.

“We spent years watching riders leave disappointed after being stuck in small riding zones, hit with extra charges or handed tired equipment. We knew there was a better way, so we built it.”

No passenger fees

Brand-new life jackets for every rider

Open 7 days


Our story

Our guests

Real guests. Real water.

5.0

★★★★★

600+ Google reviews

Couples, families, birthday crews and visitors from as far as the UK and Germany. These are our guests, on our skis, on the water we ride every day.


Read Google reviews


See us on Yelp

The fleet

Brand-new Yamaha WaveRunners

Smooth handling, strong acceleration and seating built for two. Easy for first-timers, with plenty left for riders who want to open it up.

Bluetooth audio. Bring the playlist.

Two-up seating. Ride together, no passenger fee.

Stable and beginner-friendly. Confident in minutes.

Maintained and inspected by our crew, because reliability matters out there.

Before you ride

Four things to know

01

Boater card

Born on or after January 1, 1988? Florida law requires a boater safety card to drive. The temporary one takes minutes online.


Get your boater card

02

Bring your ID

Renters must be 18+ with a valid government-issued photo ID. International guests can use a passport. No deposit needed.

03

Arrive 30 minutes early

Your reservation time is your water time. Groups of 5 or more, plan on arriving an hour ahead.

04

Weather happens

We watch the marine forecast every day. If conditions are unsafe, you get a full refund or an easy reschedule.

Up to 2 riders or 400 lb per ski. Younger riders can ride with a parent or guardian. See the FAQ for age details.

FAQ

Questions we get every day

Still wondering about something? Call or text us at (813) 538-4802.


All FAQs

When should I arrive?

↓

Please arrive 30 minutes before your reservation. Groups of 5 or more should arrive an hour ahead. Your reservation time is your water time, so late arrivals may mean less time on the water.

Where can we ride?

↓

On most days you can explore the Gulf of Mexico, Boca Ciega Bay and Tampa Bay. For safety, we adjust boundaries each morning based on wind and tide.

Do I need a boating license?

↓

Florida law requires anyone born on or after January 1, 1988 to carry a boater education card to operate a jet ski. You can get a temporary card online in minutes before you arrive.

I've never ridden a jet ski. Is that OK?

↓

Absolutely. Many of our guests are first-timers. You'll get a full orientation on the controls, steering and safety before you launch, and most riders feel comfortable within minutes.

Do you require a deposit?

↓

No deposit required. A valid payment method and a government-issued photo ID are all you need at check-in.

Will we see dolphins?

↓

Wildlife is never guaranteed, but dolphin encounters are very common in the waters around Fort De Soto. Our guides keep a respectful distance so the animals stay comfortable.

St. Petersburg, FL  ·  Open 7 days

The Gulf's open.
Your ski's waiting.

Book online in a couple of minutes, or call and we'll help you pick the right ride.


Check Availability


Call (813) 538-4802
